title: A Rust-Colored Whisper
narration: What if you stood on a world half Earth's size, with thin air and rust-red ground? That's Mars—familiar yet alien. Why does this dead world call us back?
visual_goal: Opening shot of Mars against black space, rotating, showing red surface and polar ice caps.

title: The Long Road
narration: Between fifty-four point six and four hundred one million kilometers away. In nineteen sixty-five, Mariner four flew past, returning twenty-two images—revealing a cratered world, not canals. We sent a robot that changed our view. It went silent, leaving a whisper.
visual_goal: Animation of Earth-to-Mars distance, then grainy black-and-white Mariner 4 images.

title: First Touch
narration: In nineteen seventy-one, Soviet Mars three made the first landing, transmitting for fourteen seconds before falling silent. That brief whisper proved we could reach the surface. We had touched—enough to keep going.
visual_goal: Illustration of Mars 3 lander on dusty surface, signal drop graphic.

title: We Stayed
narration: Every robot is a test. Curiosity rolled thirty kilometers since twenty twelve, finding ancient lakes. Ingenuity made seventy-two flights in thin air. Perseverance collects samples for Earth return. Each step rehearses for humans.
visual_goal: Time-lapse of rover tracks, cut to Ingenuity flying, then sample tubes.

title: The Next Step
narration: Olympus Mons towers twenty-one point nine kilometers—two point five Everests. Valles Marineris swallows the Grand Canyon. NASA targets the 2030s. That first human footprint will weigh more than all Martian mountains—ours by exploration.
visual_goal: Aerial view of Olympus Mons and Valles Marineris, fade to rocket silhouette on horizon.
